name: @ham2k/lib-qso-party
description: The shared QSO-party engine: scoring, exchange handling and submittable files for state, provincial and regional QSO parties
author: Sebastian Delmont <sd@ham2k.com>
//exports: Consumed as TypeScript source: the only consumers are extensions, which
esbuild bundles, so there is no build step and no dist/ to point at.
//dependencies: The Cabrillo WRITER arrived in lib-qson-cabrillo 1.2.0, so that is the
floor: the host holds its own copy of this library and an extension built
against an older one finds no writer at runtime.
//peerDependencies: The SDK is provided by the extension that consumes this package: its own
bundle carries one copy, rewritten to the host's instance at build time.
